# Barcode Generator & Scanner
> High-Resolution 1D Barcode Generator and In-Browser Camera Scanner

## Project Overview
Barcode Studio is a free, high-speed, 100% client-side web utility engineered to generate standards-compliant linear 1D barcodes (Code 128 and Code 39) with vector SVG/PNG export, and scan physical barcodes directly using webcam feeds or uploaded images with audio feedback.

## Canonical URL
https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/barcode/

## Core Features
- Native Code 128 (subset B) and Code 39 mathematical symbology generation.
- Real-time HTML5 Canvas and Vector SVG rendering with customizable bar height, scale, and text labels.
- Export options: Crisp PNG download, scalable SVG vectors, and direct print label mode.
- In-browser Barcode Scanner: Reads codes via device camera or drag-and-drop images using the Barcode Detection API.
- Integrated Web Audio API scan confirmation beep (1750 Hz synthesized pulse).
- 100% Client-Side Privacy: Zero barcode payload or camera data is transmitted across the internet.

## Target Audience
Warehouse managers, retail inventory specialists, e-commerce merchants, logistics dispatchers, and developers needing instant barcode creation and verification.
